headline: TSMC leads the charge as Taiex surges 1,562 points intraday, the 8th-largest intraday gain on record | Securities
summary: The Taiex opened higher and hit an intraday high of 44,923.06 points, up 1,562.4 points, the eighth-largest intraday gain on record. Signs of progress in US-Iran negotiations raised hopes the Strait of Hormuz will reopen.
why: The Taiex is Taiwan's benchmark stock index, and TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker, so its share price weighs heavily on the index.

impacts.name: Taiex
impacts.why: The benchmark index rallied sharply intraday on hopes of a US-Iran deal and a Hormuz reopening.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Signs of progress in US-Iran negotiations raised hopes the Strait of Hormuz would reopen. Oil prices fell, US stocks hit record highs, and Taiwan shares rallied in response.
